Class EquinixNotFoundException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.exception.BaseException
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.exception.EquinixServiceException
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.exception.EquinixNotFoundException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EquinixNotFoundException extends EquinixServiceException
Thrown when the Equinix API returns HTTP 404 Not Found. This indicates the requested resource (connection, port, device, etc.) does not exist or is not accessible with the current credentials.
Author:
ianjones
